summary.title: Lutz Hühnken (@lutzhuehnken@mastodon.social)
summary.one_liner: This is a Mastodon profile of a fractional engineering leader promoting an event-driven architecture (EDA) training course in Hamburg, not a technical article.
takeaways: Lutz Hühnken is a fractional engineering leader and software architect with 20+ years in distributed systems and messaging.
He offers a practical EDA training covering architecture, event design and proven patterns.
The next session is on 26-27 November in Hamburg, listed on the OOSE seminar page.
Participant feedback praises the broad overview and the depth on expected problems; an early-bird discount was offered for a limited time.
summary.summary: This Mastodon profile page for Lutz Hühnken shows his bio, follow counts, and a pinned post in German. The pinned post promotes his event-driven architecture (EDA) training, quotes participant feedback, and gives the next date (26-27 November, Hamburg) with a link to the OOSE seminar page. The page contains no technical content itself; it is a promotional profile listed as a footnote in an awesome-event-driven-architecture list.
